# High-Recall Routing: MAC-010 (IMF 2022 Article IV — Mexico) × Chapter 5B (Economic Wellbeing)

**Router:** high-recall evidence calibration (non-scoring)  
**Source:** MAC-010 | IMF 2022 Article IV Consultation — Mexico  
**Questions targeted:** Chapter 5B (economic_wellbeing), questions 5B.1–5B.10  
**Recall posture:** maximum — include any chunk bearing on economic policy quality, implementation, distribution, trajectory, or institutional integrity under the ruler's economic stewardship

---
